title: chromamancer target mapping v1
description: Per-target canonical → native key map and optional apply_quick / apply_nix defaults. File: targets/<target_id>/mapping.jsonc

canonical_to_native.description: Canonical color key → native config key path (adapter-defined string; e.g. Kitty color0, Kvantum GeneralColors.window.color).

apply_quick.description: Optional defaults for chromamancer apply-quick (paths, flags).

apply_nix.description: Optional defaults for chromamancer apply-nix (e.g. themes_dir, theme_file_template).
